visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black glasses and a yellow Keith Haring-style t-shirt enters through a white-framed glass door onto a wooden deck area. The lighting is warm indoor lighting. He speaks animatedly with hand gestures and facial expressions showing high energy. (2) He stands on a digital weighing scale in a hallway. He wears grey shorts. There is a wooden shoe rack and a refrigerator in the background. The camera is handheld, following his movements closely. (3) Close-up of an OMRON body composition monitor. Fingers press buttons. The display shows numeric data for weight and fat. Background is a grey outdoor pavement with a blue yoga mat and kettlebells. (4) The man sits on wooden steps, looking down at his feet with a frustrated expression. He wears a yellow t-shirt and grey shorts. The setting is dimly lit with artificial indoor light. (5) Indoors, the man and a woman in a white t-shirt clink glasses filled with beer. They laugh and talk. A wooden shelf with glass doors is in the background. The man holds a half-filled beer glass. (6) Kitchen scene: the man stands behind a white counter. He prepares chicken, seasoning it in a blue bowl with salt and pepper. Close-ups show detailed slicing of raw chicken and onions on a wooden board. (7) Cooking sequence: Onions and cauliflower rice are stir-fried in a black pan over a gas stove with visible flames. He adds a creamy yellow sauce from a plastic container. Steam rises from the pan. (8) Plating and Eating: He scoops yellow curry onto a bowl of white rice, garnishes with sliced tomatoes and cucumbers. He sits at a wooden dining table, eating and talking to the camera. A glass of tea is on the table. (9) Night outdoor workout: The man, now in a grey t-shirt, performs push-ups and planks on a blue mat in a grassy yard. A white dog sits calmly nearby. He holds up his arm to show an Apple Watch screen with fitness data.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice narrating with fast speech rate and dynamic pitch variability. There is light background music with a steady 110 BPM. Subtle ambient room tone is present. He emphasizes certain words with increased loudness. (2) Male voice groaning in disappointment over the rhythmic beeping of a digital body scale. The background music continues at a low volume. The beeps are sharp transients with narrow spectral bandwidth. (3) Sounds of liquid pouring into a glass followed by a clear metallic clinking of glasses. The man's voice is casual and accompanied by light female laughter in the background. The acoustic environment shifts to a more resonant indoor space. (4) Rapid, percussive sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board at a fast tempo. The man narrates his cooking process with high articulation clarity. Occasional rustling sounds of plastic packaging and metal tins being handled are audible. (5) Intense broadband white-noise-like sizzling from a frying pan dominates the mix. The man's voice remains projected above the noise. Rhythmic scraping of a wooden utensil against a metal surface occurs frequently. (6) Soft clicking and scraping sounds of a metal spoon against a ceramic bowl. The man provides a food review with audible chewing and swallowing sounds, lowering his vocal intensity and speech rate significantly. (7) Acoustic environment transitions to an outdoor night setting with faint natural cricket chirps. The man's voice exhibits heavy breathing, vocal strain, and grunting. Dull, low-frequency thuds of feet and hands hitting a rubber exercise mat occur periodically. (8) A bright, synthesized notification chime with high spectral centroid rings out. The man's voice is tired, showing lower arousal but remains authoritative. He concludes his vlog with a steady, falling intonation pattern.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Update -> Conflict -> Resolution -> Compensation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents day 22 of a 100-day fitness challenge, blending lifestyle vlog elements with a culinary tutorial and workout footage. The creator showcases the reality of balancing personal weight loss goals with work obligations (drinking beer for a shoot) and counters this by preparing a healthy home-cooked curry and performing late-night exercise to stay on track despite setbacks.
